name: rreview
description: Runs an rreview cross-model panel review of the focused workspace's PR, shows each pass while it runs, and lists the findings by file.

settings.title: rreview executable
settings.description: The rreview binary to run: a name on the plugin worker's PATH or an absolute path.

settings.title: GitHub account
settings.description: A gh account (gh auth status lists them) whose token gh and rreview use, for a repository gh's active account cannot see. Empty: gh's active account.
